Cooking: 10 minutes|difficulty=1 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] {{Nutrition Summary| |ServingSize= 1/8 of recipe (160 g) |Servings= 8 |Cals= 125 |FatCals= 60 |TotalFat= 6.7 g |SatFat= 2.1 g |Cholesterol= 32 mg |Sodium= 435 mg |Carbs= 10.7 g |Fiber= 1.9 g |Sugars= 5.3 g |Protein= 3.6 g |VitaminA= 6% |VitaminC= 10% |Calcium= 7% |Iron= 9% }} ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (10–12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 280–340 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) medium [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]] * 6 strips [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], cooked until crisp, or [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]] ready fully cooked bacon * 1 can (28 oz / 790 g) [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]] * ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Onion|onion powder]] * ⅛ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (15 g / 0.53 oz) sliced [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]] ==Procedure== # Peel and [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]] the potato. # Crumble crisp bacon into small pieces. # Drain green beans, keeping ½ cup of the liquid. # Put beans, bean juice, bacon, and potato in a microwave-safe baking dish. # Sprinkle onion powder and salt on top. # Cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic wrap|clear wrap]]. # Cook in [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]] oven 5 minutes, stir, and cook another 5 minutes. # Let stand 5 minutes. # [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with sliced almonds.
